episodes.title: Before the Eclipse Dies
episodes.logline: At an eclipse coronation, a captive princess must crown the regent holding her brother hostage until an enemy dragon lord invokes her forbidden claim.
episodes.dramaticQuestion: Will Lyra submit to Malrec to save her brother, or risk the lethal Ash Crown?
episodes.hook: A captive princess and a usurper face each other across a black crown while the eclipse closes.
episodes.reversal: The enemy dragon lord interrupts and declares that the crown recognizes Lyra, not Malrec.
episodes.cliffhanger: Lyra accepts the crown's lethal judgment before anyone can prove she is the true heir.
episodes.nextEpisodeOpening: The obsidian crown erupts with light as Lyra waits to learn whether it will crown or kill her.
episodes.screenDirection: In the throne hall, Kael stands far screen left, Lyra occupies center, and Malrec stands screen right. Lyra looks frame right to Malrec and frame left to Kael. Malrec always looks frame left. Kael always looks frame right. Pair changes are established by silent two-shots.

scenes.storyBeat: The eclipse, the crown, and Lyra's captivity establish an immediate forced coronation.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra has been brought before Malrec during the final minute of the eclipse.
scenes.continuityOut: The audience understands that Lyra and Malrec are locked in a confrontation over the crown.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly two people are visible in a dramatic medium two-shot. Lyra stands at frame left in a torn ivory ceremonial gown under a fitted black leather bodice, a plain black iron collar at her throat, her silver-streaked hair loose. Malrec stands at frame right in a dark crimson brocade coat with a black steel gorget. The obsidian crown rests on its stone pedestal between them beneath the red eclipse. Lyra looks frame right with defiance; Malrec looks frame left with absolute control. Neither looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lyra and Malrec hold each other's gaze across the obsidian crown. The crown catches the steady red eclipse light. The braziers hiss in the silence. The camera remains still.

scenes.storyBeat: Malrec makes the coronation a life-or-death deadline for Lyra's brother.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra and Malrec face the crown as the eclipse nears its end.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra knows refusing to crown Malrec will kill her brother.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up single of Malrec in the dark crimson brocade coat and black steel gorget, positioned frame right and looking toward empty space beyond frame left. Red eclipse light edges his severe face as he holds cold certainty; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec speaks immediately toward frame left, his low voice ceremonial and merciless: "Crown me before the eclipse closes, or your brother dies beneath us." He barely blinks. A deep bell begins tolling. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra rejects the threat because she believes Malrec already murdered her family.
scenes.continuityIn: Malrec claims Lyra's brother is alive and hostage.
scenes.continuityOut: Malrec must prove the hostage is real.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up single of Lyra in the torn ivory ceremonial gown, fitted black leather bodice, and plain black iron collar, positioned frame left and looking toward empty space beyond frame right. Her amber eyes hold grief sharpened into hatred; she never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lyra answers immediately toward frame right, her clear voice carrying furious disbelief: "My brother died when you burned House Aster from the sky." Her jaw tightens through the final words. The bell toll continues. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Malrec reveals that Lyra's brother survived and is imprisoned below the hall.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra has called Malrec's hostage threat a lie.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra believes her brother may still be alive and the choice becomes real.

scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec replies immediately toward frame left, savoring each word in a calm, fully audible voice: "He lives. One word from me, and the oubliette becomes his tomb." A restrained smile reaches one corner of his mouth. Chains rattle far below. The camera stays locked.

scenes.continuityIn: Malrec claims Lyra's brother is alive in the oubliette.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra's anger gives way to fear that the hostage is real.

scenes.storyBeat: Kael interrupts the coronation and establishes himself as Malrec's opposing power.
scenes.continuityIn: Lyra is close to surrendering to save her brother.
scenes.continuityOut: Malrec must confront the dragon lord who has entered on Lyra's behalf.

scenes.continuityOut: Lyra's claim now threatens every surviving throne, not only Malrec.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up single of Malrec in the crimson brocade coat and black steel gorget, positioned frame right and looking toward empty space beyond frame left. His composure has become open contempt; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec fires back immediately toward frame left, his voice sharp and public: "She is bloodless, kingdomless, and condemned by every throne still standing." His nostrils flare as the claim leaves him. The braziers crackle. The camera stays locked.

scenes.continuityIn: Malrec has declared Lyra powerless and universally condemned.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra hears that the dragons may answer to her blood despite the fallen realm.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Chest-up single of Kael in black scale armor and dark red cloak, positioned frame left and looking toward empty space beyond frame right. His expression holds dangerous certainty; he never looks at the camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Kael answers immediately toward frame right, his deep voice steady and edged with warning: "Then every throne is about to remember why dragons kneel to hers." A faint roar answers beyond the window. Kael does not look away. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra and Kael face each other for the first time, establishing distrust inside their alliance.

scenes.continuityOut: Lyra must decide whether Kael is another captor or a path to power.

scenes.continuityOut: Kael must offer Lyra agency rather than ownership.

scenes.continuityIn: Lyra has rejected any alliance that makes her Kael's possession.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra can claim the crown without surrendering her autonomy.

scenes.videoPrompt: Kael replies immediately toward frame right, his voice quiet but carrying absolute commitment: "Take the crown and command me—or let your brother die unavenged." He opens one empty hand at his side. The braziers hiss softly. The camera stays locked.

scenes.continuityIn: Lyra now has a path to power and a reason to take it.
scenes.continuityOut: Claiming the crown becomes a potentially fatal test of Lyra's blood.

scenes.videoPrompt: Malrec speaks immediately toward frame left, his voice suddenly eager and cruel: "Touch it, and the Ash Crown will burn a false heir alive." His eyes brighten with expectation. The eclipse bell strikes once. The camera stays locked.

scenes.storyBeat: Lyra accepts the crown's lethal judgment rather than surrender her brother or bloodline.
scenes.continuityIn: Malrec expects the crown either to kill Lyra or frighten her into obedience.
scenes.continuityOut: Lyra has chosen the test, but the episode cuts before the crown judges her.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exactly one person is visible. Tight chest-up single of Lyra in the torn ivory gown, black bodice, and iron collar directly behind the stone pedestal.
